_meanings:
Ignorance, unconsciousness; especially,
 spirtual ignorance ({#avidyA#}) which makes one consider his self as distinct
 from the Supreme spirit and the material world as a reality. According
 to the Vedāntins, {#ajYAna#} is not merely a negative principle ({#jYAnasya#}
 {#aBAvaH#}), but a distinct positive principle; <ab>oft.</ab> identified with {#mAyA#},
 {#prakfti#} <ab>&c.</ab> See {#avidyA#} also In compounds {#ajYAna#} may be translated
 by ‘unawares’, ‘inadvertently’, ‘unconsciously’; {#˚Acarita, ˚uccArita#}
 <ab>&c.</ab>; {#˚nataH, -˚nena, ˚nAt#} unawares, inadvertently, unconsciously,
 unwillingly {#˚taH svacaritaM nfpatiH SaSaMsa#} <ls>R. 9. 77</ls> committed unintentionally
 or unconsciously.
